ios.desc:
Lullamon Baby Monitor transforms your iPhone or iPad into a secure, reliable baby monitor — with no ads, no subscriptions, and no internet required.

Simply connect two Apple devices on the same Wi-Fi and start streaming instantly. Whether you use your old iPhone, iPad, or both, Lullamon keeps you close to your baby with a private and encrypted connection.

Key Features:
* 100% Free, No Ads: Focus on what matters most without distractions.
* Real-Time Streaming: Watch and listen to your baby live on another iPhone or iPad.
* Reuse Old Devices: Give your older Apple devices a new purpose as a dedicated monitor.
* Automatic Device Discovery: Find and connect devices on your Wi-Fi network in seconds.
* Passcode Protected: Only you can connect, thanks to secure 6-digit authentication.
* Local Wi-Fi Only: Works offline — no cloud, no internet required for peace of mind.
* Encrypted Connection: Ensures your baby’s stream is private and secure.
* Lock screen button for power saving on monitor.

Why Choose Lullamon?

Unlike other monitors, Lullamon is built for privacy and simplicity. No monthly fees, no third-party servers, and no complex setup. Just download the app on two devices, connect, and you’re ready to go.

Perfect for parents who want a safe, affordable, and easy-to-use baby monitor.

show_hn.title: Show HN: WebRTC LAN Baby Monitor for iOS and iPadOS

quotes.text:
Hey all,

Just wanted to show off this app I built, its a LAN based WebRTC baby monitor that connects any apple devices together over WIFI so you can turn an old iPad or iPhone into a baby monitor!

I got a bit sick of all the sketchy products that require you to buy another device and may or may not connect to Chinese servers and store all your information somewhere.

So I figured what if there were no servers and we could just use our existing devices!

I would love any feedback! You will need two apple devices to test it, but simulators do work.
